name: Core Passive: Pale Blood Feast
Additional Ability: Bloodline Legacy
desc:
All DMG dealt by Claret's skills is Sharp DMG, using DEF as the DMG Multiplier. Sharp DMG accumulates Gash value. When the Gash value is full, the enemy enters [Gash]. [Gash] can stack up to 3 times. When [Special Attack: Blood Oath - Sever Gold and Sunder Iron] or [Special Attack: Blood Oath - Crimson Onslaught] hits an enemy afflicted with [Gash], or when Claret defeats an enemy afflicted with [Gash], one stack of [Gash] is consumed, triggering [Maim] and dealing AoE DMG.
When a CRIT is triggered, Laceration DMG replaces CRIT DMG for calculation. When CRIT Rate exceeds 100% and a CRIT is triggered, an additional Laceration check is performed, with the Laceration probability equal to the excess CRIT Rate. For every 1% of initial CRIT DMG Claret possesses, her initial CRIT Rate increases by 0.35%.
When Claret enters the battlefield, she recovers 60 Sharpness. In Investigation Zone mode, this effect can trigger once every 180 seconds.
While Claret is in [Scarlet Inscription], or during [Chain Attack: Blood Oath - Blood Pact Resonance], [Ultimate: Blood Oath - Thousand Tempered], or [Assist Follow-Up: Blood Oath - Immaculate Molten Edge], her Anti-Interrupt level is increased, CRIT Rate increases by <color=#POSITIVE_WITH_GREYITE>15%</color>, Gash Buildup Rate increases by <color=#POSITIVE_WITH_GREYITE>20%</color>, and if a Perfect Dodge is triggered during [Basic Attack: Blood Oath - Forge Star] or [Basic Attack: Blood Oath - Ambush Cleave] skill attacks, DMG dealt for the remainder of the skill is increased by 15%.

When another character in your squad is a <color=#FFFFFF>[Stun]</color> Character, another <color=#FFFFFF>[Armorer]</color>, or a Character with the same attribute, the following effects are triggered:
When Claret triggers [Contamination], she recovers 300 Decibels. This can be triggered at most once every 15 sec.
When Claret or a squad member triggers [Maim], all [Armorer] Agents in the squad enter [Lingering Edge]. While in the [Lingering Edge] state, Laceration DMG increases by <color=#FFFFFF>25%</color> for 40 sec. Re-entering [Lingering Edge] refreshes its duration.

1.desc: [Crimson Inscription] max duration is extended by 3s; when Claret is in [Crimson Inscription], or during [Chain Attack: Blood Pact Oath - Blood Pact Resonance], [Ultimate: Blood Pact Oath - Tempered Thousandfold], or [Assist Follow-Up: Blood Pact Oath - Pristine Molten Edge], attacks that hit ignore 16% of the target's <color=#2EB6FF>Electric RES</color>.

2.desc: When Claret's attack hits an enemy and triggers a Sharp Crit, Gash Buildup Rate increases by 20%; the DMG Multiplier of DMG dealt when Claret triggers [Maim] increases to 130% of its original value.

4.desc: During the 3rd hit of [Basic Attack: Blood Oath - Star Forge], the duration of consecutive Slashes can be extended; DMG dealt by the 3rd hit of [Basic Attack: Blood Oath - Star Forge], [Chain Attack: Blood Oath - Blood Pact Resonance], and [Ultimate: Blood Oath - Tempered Resolve] increases by 20%.

6.desc: When Claret's [Chain Attack: Blood Blossom Oath - Blood Pact Resonance] or [Ultimate: Blood Blossom Oath - Tempered Thousandfold] heavy attack hits an enemy, directly triggers 1 instance of single-target [Maim].
